title: 2-Stage Relief Solenoid Short Circuit
detail_of_failure: The pump controller senses a ground fault in the 2-stage relief solenoid circuit.
controller_action: • Stops to drive the 2-stage relief solenoid. • Even if the cause of the failure is naturally resolved, the machine does not become normal until the starting switch is turned to the OFF position once.
machine_effect: • The traveling force becomes weak. (The main relief valve is not switched to high pressure setting.) • The one-touch power maximizing function does not operate.
related_information: Monitoring code The command (ON or OFF) from the controller to the 2-stage relief solenoid can be monitored. (As long as the command from the controller is ON, the indication on the monitor is ON even if the solenoid is not energized because there is an open circuit.) (Code: 02300) Reference information The controller senses an open circuit when the solenoid output is OFF.

steps.procedure: 1. Check the wiring harnesses and connectors. REMARK For details of checking method, see “RELATED INFORMATION TO TROUBLESHOOT”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”. 2. Are the wiring harnesses and connectors normal?

branches.YES: • The wiring harnesses and connectors are normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • A wiring harness or connector is defective. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness or connector. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.
